subject: Life Skills
title: The 80/20 Rule
description: A quick win: understand The 80/20 Rule.

hook.text: Italian economist Vilfredo Pareto noticed 80% of Italy's land was owned by 20% of the people in 1896.

buildup.text: The pattern repeated everywhere. 80% of sales from 20% of clients. 80% of bugs from 20% of code.

discovery.text: Applied to your day: roughly 20% of your tasks generate 80% of your results. The rest is mostly noise.

twist.text: The hard part is admitting that most of your to-do list does not matter much. It feels productive but is not.

climax.text: Each morning, identify your top two or three high-impact tasks. Protect them before anything else creeps in.

punchline.text: Find the vital few. Ignore the trivial many.

quiz.question: What does the 80/20 rule suggest about your daily tasks?
options: You should complete 80% of tasks before lunch
A small fraction of tasks produces most of your results
